title: Great app overall with room for improvement.
body:
The Samsung app integrates wonderfully with the watch (gear s3 frontier).

Been using it to track my food and sleep.

if they could add a feature to calculate your custom food by gram it would have been a 5 stars flat out.

And also if we could set custom calorie goals for certain days. For example Monday it’s a surplus and Tuesday is a deficit.

Looking forward to these features in a future update!

title: Synchronisation des données
body:
J'adore cette application depuis que je lutilisais avec mon galaxy k zoom et mon gear fit . Mes données de comptes je les ai gardé quand j'ai installé cette application sur ios , j'aurais aimé avoir pous d'accessibilité vers l'application santé de ios pour corrélation des données , pour avancer dans mon niveau.

title: Needs enhancements
body: The app is Good, but I don’t see why the part of the app on the watch doesn’t have quite popular activities like tennis and soccer, also the app doesn’t have any widgets!! Plus it can’t export the data to the built-in health app on iOS.. that’s all which I see a necessity rather than an improvement really!!!
